call.otherwise.help: Where the flow goes when the result it ended with has no link of its own.
code.help: Kotlin code placed in the story as it is.
function.flow.heading: Flows
function.name: Name
function.param.heading: Parameters
function.result.heading: Results
group.title: Title
option.condition.help: The condition that offers this option, the if= of @choice.
phrase.format:
Text markup: bold, italic, underlined, struck, color, gradient, , , , , , , ,
for a new line.
phrase.speaker: Speaker
phrase.speaker.help: Who says the line: a name, or {expression} for an entity. Empty is the narrator.
phrase.text.help: {name} puts in a variable, {player} the name of the player, {mod.key} a translation. A whole line can be a translation key too.
pin.empty: The value may be missing, and the story then stops with an error. Check it with "Has value?" or give a fallback with "Or default".
problem.animation_similar: This model has no animation "%s". Did you mean: %s?
problem.bool: true, false or an expression goes here
problem.code: The expression is unfinished: check its brackets and quotes
problem.generic_mismatch: Values of different types go in: %s. They have nothing in common but Any
problem.graph.bad_function: '%s' is not a name of a function
problem.graph.bad_id: A node id may only hold letters, digits and _
problem.graph.bad_value_name: '%s' is not a name of a value
problem.graph.bad_variable: '%s' is not a name of a variable
problem.graph.code_outputs: Code in the flow gives values through its outputs
problem.graph.function_entry: A function needs one block of its parameters to start from
problem.graph.import_cycle: Story '%s' already calls this one, so this one cannot call it
problem.graph.loop_item: The item of a loop only exists in the body of that loop
problem.graph.loop_item_merged: Flow gets here through a node several links lead to, which runs apart from the loop and cannot read its item: put the item into a variable first
problem.graph.missing_node: A link joins a missing node: %s
problem.graph.needs_return: '%s' is read later, so it needs its return type
problem.graph.needs_start: '%s' needs a value to start with
problem.graph.no_return: The function ends here without giving back its result
problem.graph.no_type_name: Write the type to cast to
problem.graph.other_branch: Flow can get here without passing the node this value comes from
problem.graph.other_outcome: Flow can get here without the call ending with the result this value belongs to
problem.graph.own_value: This node reads its own value
problem.graph.reserved_name: '%s' is a name the story generates for itself
problem.graph.return_place: A function returns only from its own flow, outside of loops and blocks
problem.graph.stage_in_block: This node runs apart from the steps around it, which a block such as 'temporary' cannot hold
problem.graph.start_in_function: A function starts at its parameters
problem.graph.untyped_block: Link the block to a value: it takes its type from the link
problem.graph.value_in_flow: A value has no place in the flow
problem.location: A path like namespace:path goes here, in lowercase
problem.name: A name holds letters, digits and _, starts with no digit and is no word of the language
problem.unreachable: The story never gets here, so this node will not run
reroute.help: A point a link passes through, to lead it around other nodes. Drag it to move it, Alt and drag to pull another link out of it, double-click a link to put one on it. Deleting it joins the link back up.
set.result.help: The value once written. The node can stay out of the flow: it writes when its value is read.
variable.help: A Kotlin expression, such as listOf(1, 2).
variable.name: Name
variable.type.help: Any Kotlin type. With ? at the end the variable can be empty and needs no starting value.
vector.story_player: Player of the story (when it runs)
